comment: RTX 5090 lock for the C1+D10 CUDA build (CUDA_MILESTONES.md D10): the C1 patch d2579af2 plus D10 (GPU TB encoder kept its own LDPC filler count when the CPU segmenter supplied F=0, so zero-filler multi-CB TBs such as 9474 bytes = 9 BG1 CBs were encoded with the wrong K; found on GB10 in S13). D8/D9 are not in this lineage. Separate checkout src/ocudu-cuda-c1d10 and build; builds/c1-cuda-patched stays the C1 evidence build.
